snippet.description:
2024's "Beverly Hills Cop: Axel F" humorously references the critically panned "Beverly Hills Cop III," which Eddie Murphy himself called "garbage." The third film, released in 1994, suffered from a low-budget plot set in a theme park instead of its intended overseas setting, receiving poor reviews and grossing less than half of the second film. Eddie Murphy attributes its failure to the absence of Sergeant John Taggart (John Ashton), a weak villain, and clichéd script elements. snippet.title: Why The Final Seasons Of These Shows Should Have Never Happened
snippet.description:
Iconic TV shows often stumble in their final seasons, leaving fans disappointed and wishing for earlier endings. "The Flight Attendant" lost charm in its second season, while "That '70s Show" struggled after key cast changes. "Scrubs" Season 9 felt disconnected, and "Once Upon A Time" should have ended earlier for a more satisfying conclusion. "The Wire" declined in its fifth season, "Roseanne" became unrealistic, and "Gilmore Girls" lost its wit. "Game of Thrones" famously rushed its conclusion, diverging from its source material and leaving fans wanting more.
